title: Sales & Business Development Executive
salary_text: £28000 - £30000 per year (discretionary bonus based on perform)
description:
Just Recruitment is delighted to be partnering with a thriving and ambitious business on the outskirts of Ipswich to recruit a Sales & Business Development Executive.
This is an excellent opportunity for a customer-focused and commercially minded individual to join a growing team, supporting client relationships, account management and new business development.
Key Responsibilities
Quotation Management: Prepare and issue accurate service quotations, ensuring customers receive timely and professional responses.
CRM Management: Maintain accurate and up-to-date sales pipeline information, ensuring client details, contact records and contract terms are correctly recorded.
Client Onboarding: Act as a key point of contact for new and existing customers, ensuring service agreements are completed, signed and filed appropriately.
Customer Retention & Account Management: Conduct regular check-in calls and account reviews to monitor customer satisfaction, strengthen relationships and identify opportunities to introduce additional waste management services.
Pricing & Customer Queries: Handle pricing enquiries, including price increase discussions, providing clear explanations and maintaining positive customer relationships.
Internal Liaison: Work closely with the Sales, Transport and Accounts teams to ensure effective communication and seamless service delivery.
Account Development: Review existing customer accounts to identify opportunities for growth, improve service levels and maximise customer retention.
Required Skills & Experience
Customer Service: Proven experience handling customer enquiries professionally, taking ownership of queries from initial contact through to resolution and ensuring a positive customer experience.
Administrative Excellence: Strong organisational skills, excellent attention to detail and a right-first-time approach, particularly when handling customer records, contracts and waste documentation where accuracy is essential for compliance.
Communication Skills: The ability to communicate confidently and professionally, explaining service information and compliance requirements clearly to customers.
IT Skills: Confident using CRM systems, such as Salesforce or HubSpot, alongside Microsoft Office, particularly Excel.
Relationship Management: The ability to build and maintain strong customer relationships, identify opportunities to develop existing accounts and contribute to long-term business growth.
Commercial Awareness: A proactive approach to identifying additional service opportunities while balancing customer satisfaction with business objectives.

title: Customer Service Apprentice
description:
Job Type: Apprenticeship
Location: Bury St Edmunds
Hours: 40 hours per week, Monday Friday
Apprenticeship wage & Benefits

At Hayley Dexis we ve built-up our reputation over the course of the last five decades with stock, service and people at the core of everything we do.

We are entering an exciting period of growth and our 1300 people, doing things the Hayley Way along with industry leading customer service are central to our success.

We re excited to offer a brilliant opportunity for a Customer Service Apprentice working within a busy and supportive branch environment.

About the Customer Service Apprentice role:

As a Customer Service Apprentice, you ll gain hands-on experience across key areas of the branch, building the skills needed to deliver excellent service to our customers. You will rotate through:
- Trade Counter supporting and serving customers face-to-face
- Internal Sales / Office handling calls, emails, and customer enquiries
- Warehouse Operations understanding stock, order fulfilment, and logistics

This well-rounded approach ensures you develop a strong understanding of both our products and how we support customers from enquiry through to delivery.

You ll learn how to:
- Communicate confidently with customers and colleagues
- Handle enquiries, orders and problem-solving effectively
- Use internal systems and processes
- Deliver a high standard of customer service in a fast-paced environment

Following successful completion, there may be the opportunity to progress into a Customer Service or Internal Sales role.

About the Apprenticeship:
- Customer Service Specialists level 3
- Duration: typically, 15 months
- Study and coursework completed during working hours
- Regular support from a training provider and your manager

What we re looking for in our Customer Service Apprentice:
- A genuine interest in customer service and building a career
- Enthusiastic, motivated and willing to learn
- Good communication skills (verbal and written)
- GCSEs (or equivalent) in English and Maths
- Basic IT skills (including Microsoft Office)
- Strong attention to detail and logical thinking
- Well-presented and professional approach
- Able to travel to and work locally

No prior experience is required just the right attitude and commitment to learning.

What you ll get in return:
- Apprenticeship salary
- 23 days annual leave (plus public/bank holidays)
- Uniform and PPE provided
- Training and development provided through our own Hayley Academy

What to expect from our recruitment process:
- Initial screening
- Microsoft Teams interview with our Talent team
- Face to face interview
- Decision outcome

We ll close this role on Sunday 22nd November, but may do so earlier if we receive strong interest so don t miss out.

A final note

Not sure you tick every box? Please don t let that stop you from applying.

Need any reasonable adjustments? Just give our talent acquisition team a shout.

Any questions on your mind? Please reach out to us at (url removed)

title: Internal Sales Account Manager
description:
We are currently recruiting on behalf of an established and growing business operating within a specialist technical services sector. This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced sales professional to join a successful team in a role combining new business development, account management and project sales.

The successful candidate will take ownership of a portfolio of customers while also identifying and developing new commercial opportunities. You will work with a varied client base, helping them find the right solutions for their projects.

Key Duties & Responsibilities:
- Develop and maintain strong, long-term relationships with existing customers.
- Identify and pursue new business opportunities through proactive sales activity.
- Handle incoming sales enquiries and convert opportunities into profitable business.
- Research prospective customers and generate new leads using a range of sources and sales tools.
- Contact prospective clients by telephone, email and other appropriate channels.
- Understand customer requirements and recommend suitable solutions.
- Review project information, drawings and specifications to establish customer requirements.
- Prepare accurate and commercially competitive quotations.
- Follow up quotations and manage opportunities through to completion.
- Maintain accurate customer, opportunity and sales information within the company's CRM system.
- Provide a high level of customer service throughout the sales process.
- Develop knowledge of the company's products and technical solutions, with full training provided.
- Work closely with internal teams to ensure projects and customer requirements are handled efficiently.
- Contribute ideas and feedback

Previous Skills & Experience:
- Proven Sales Account Management or BDM experience, with a proactive approach to developing profitable relationships
- Outstanding communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build successful, mutually beneficial business relationships
- Strong sales and negotiation skills, with the ability to handle and overcome objections
- Enthusiastic, self-motivated, and focused on meeting and exceeding targets
- Excellent planning, organisational, and time management skills

Salary: 28,000- 33,000 + uncapped commission
